items.title: Accor Builds Caution Into Outlook Over France Unrest and Middle East
items.snippet: Skift Take: Accor is guiding to a flat fourth quarter globally, partly out of caution after France's recent riots and uncertainty about wars in the Middle East. Accor is bracing for a bumpy end to the year because of uncertainty in two of its key markets.

items.title: IHG reports Q3 RevPAR growth driven by ‘strength of US economy’
items.snippet: ” Q3 performance was also driven by “growth in all three demand drivers,” across the Americas, with group room revenue up by 12% YOY, leisure up 7% and business up 6%. The “tail end of the World Cup” added 40 basis points to IHG’s U.S. RevPAR growth in Q3, according to Glover.

items.title: Hotel Review: Mount Juliet Estate, County Kilkenny
items.snippet: Fresh from an extensive refurbishment, Mount Juliet Estate pairs Georgian character with Michelin-starred dining, championship golf, attentive service and an extraordinary roster of country pursuits across 500 acres in Kilkenny.

items.title: Hotel Industry Growth May Moderate in Q3 as Base Normalises: Jefferies Report
items.snippet: India’s hotel industry may witness a moderation in revenue per available room (RevPAR) growth in the third quarter of FY27 as the base effect normalises. However, a strong wedding calendar in 2027 is expected to support demand and sustain healthy growth into FY28, according to a report by brokerage firm Jefferies.

items.title: Speedy Arrivals, Seamless Stays: How Hotel June Malibu Eliminated Wait Times With Canary's Mobile Key
items.snippet: Hotel June Malibu cut check-in wait times from 7 minutes to zero using Canary Technologies' Mobile Key and Mobile Check-In, with over half of mobile check-ins now opting for a mobile key.

items.title: Singapore Airlines upgrades KrisWorld with 4K Entertainment
items.snippet: Singapore Airlines (SIA) is enhancing its in-flight entertainment experience with next-generation KrisWorld and high-speed connectivity, offering passengers greater choice, control and flexibility during their journeys.

items.title: Madame Tussauds, MakeMyTrip launch Icons of India Campaign
items.snippet: Madame Tussauds Singapore and MakeMyTrip have partnered to launch the ‘Icons of India’ campaign, a limited-period experience celebrating Diwali and the global appeal of Indian cinema. The initiative highlights the glamour and cultural influence of Bollywood while offering visitors new opportunities to engage with celebrated Indian film stars at the Singapore attraction.

items.title: Swiggy’s India ownership shift could lift Instamart margins; Q2 loss widens to Rs 922 crore
items.snippet: Swiggy is transitioning to an India-owned structure to gain greater control over its Instamart operations and improve margins. The company aims to enhance profitability while managing competition from rival services like Blinkit and Zepto. Instamart's contribution margin is projected to improve, and overall growth is anticipated over the coming quarters.

items.title: Harajuku Tokyo Cafe raises $3 million in Pre-Series A funding round
items.snippet: Over the next two quarters, Harajuku plans to open ten outlets across new neighbourhoods in Delhi NCR and Mumbai, while entering Bengaluru and Chandigarh for the first time. The company also plans to operationalise central kitchens in Mumbai and Bengaluru by December 2026.

items.title: Accor signs Novotel Solan Kumarhatti, marking its entry into Himachal Pradesh
items.snippet: Accor has signed Novotel Solan Kumarhatti, marking the hospitality group’s entry into Himachal Pradesh. Scheduled to open in 2031, the 120-key hotel will strengthen Accor’s presence in India’s emerging leisure destinations, with a focus on wellness, family travel, destination weddings and MICE. Located along the Kalka–Shimla Highway, the property will offer convenient access to Kasauli, Chail and Shimla.
